verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a SaaS experimentation platform, but the evidence pack never documents a bulk export of experiment or flag data in open formats. The management APIs for creating and controlling flags, holdouts and mutex groups are programmatic management controls, not a documented data-export capability. JSON payloads are flag configuration variables, not an export path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
